title: Build Execution Log
intro: Condensed stage-by-stage run log for tiantan_build_001.

stages.label: 01 Request
stages.summary: System receives the user request and opens the build run.

events.text: User submits workspace/Craft_Utopia/tiantan.png and targets workspace/Craft_Utopia/runs/tiantan_build_001.
System Bot registers the request, input image, output directory, and expected artifact package.
System Bot opens the Project Manager channel and forwards the build request.

stages.label: 02 PM Setup
stages.summary: Project Manager accepts the run and prepares the orchestration plan.

events.text: Project Manager accepts the run and defines the required outputs: schematic, report, replay, logs, and metadata.
Project Manager opens the Designer channel for image-to-blueprint conversion.
Project Manager reserves a Foreman council and five worker-pool rooms for the 100-worker build phase.
The run is organized around Designer output first, then packetized Foreman execution.

stages.label: 03 Design
stages.summary: Designer converts the image into blueprint artifacts for planning and construction.

events.text: Designer receives the Tiantan image path and blueprint requirements from Project Manager.
TRELLIS converts the image into a 3D mesh and camera metadata.
obj2schematic converts mesh.obj into stage_preview.schem using the project palette.
Designer exports placements.jsonl, cues.json, and uncertainty notes for build planning.
Blueprint package returns to Project Manager for packet splitting.

stages.label: 04 Foremen
stages.summary: Project Manager splits the blueprint into five Foreman packets.

events.text: Project Manager splits the build into packets A, B, C, D, and E.
Foreman-A through Foreman-E each receive one 20-worker pool covering workers 001-100.
Foremen receive seam locks, uncertainty rules, temporary tag policy, and diff-shard requirements.
Project Manager starts the five Foreman worker-pool rooms.

stages.label: 05 Build Pools
stages.summary: Five worker pools execute packets and share reusable construction skills.

events.text: Pool A starts Packet A: base lanes, dome anchors, and early placement checkpoints.
Pool B starts Packet B and avoids writes on the shared locked seam.
Pool C starts Packet C and pauses dependent rows until required gates are green.
Pool D starts Packet D and routes uncertain cells to review instead of guessing.
Pool E starts Packet E with staging, temporary tags, cleanup, and diff collection.
Place is learned by Foreman-E and shared to every Foreman worker pool.
Replace is learned by Foreman-C during a row patch and shared globally.
Pool B logs a locked-seam exception and waits for the safe handoff instead of overwriting shared cells.
Pool D defers uncertain cells for audit while submitting confirmed blocks.
Remove is learned from temporary cleanup and shared to every worker pool.
Pools A-E flush final lane summaries, patch notes, temporary-tag cleanup, and diff shards.

stages.label: 06 Return
stages.summary: Project Manager verifies the merged build and returns the final package.

events.text: Project Manager collects Foreman outputs, checkpoints, patches, and skill-cache updates.
Merged state is checked against placements.jsonl and unresolved audit notes.
Final outputs are prepared: final_world.schem, report.json, replay.jsonl, logs, and source metadata.
System Bot closes the run and packages the final schematic, reports, replay file, and log archive.
